name: Urrea de Jalón (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, over which a yellow arrow points to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Urrea de Jalón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
arrow along the band pointing to the upper fly
